summary: elevator / office elevator landing doors: mechanism_cannot_work; missing_hardware; wrong_scale

findings.description: The task is 'unlock_open_traverse', which requires the door to move, but the primary joint's whole range is 2.00 mm. A MuJoCo joint range is static: releasing the interlock cannot widen it, so the door can never open. The three pose panels are identical.

The caption states 2 leaves of 0.450 x 2.400 x 0.030 m in elevator_landing and a total of 32.1 kg. The stated area density is 29.7 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 64 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2

findings.description: The caption names operator elevator_none, and no geom on the door carries the 'operator' semantic - the part is drawn (as latch/lock/decor) but nothing the benchmark or the viewer reads as the operator.
